description: This file contains test utility functions for parsing object IDs (OIDs) and setting up hash algorithms within a testing framework for Git-related code.

methods.name: int cl_setup_hash_algo(void)
methods.description: Initializes and returns the hash algorithm to be used, based on environment variables or defaults.

methods.name: void cl_parse_oid(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Parses a hexadecimal string representing an object ID into a struct object_id, using the specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: void cl_parse_any_oid(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Determines the hash algorithm in use and parses the hex string into a struct object_id.

ctags.signature: (const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
